title: SceneX: Procedural Controllable Large-Scale Scene Generation

layout.note: Three stacked bands: a full-width strip of four slanted scene renders, a middle band of two side-by-side dashed boxes (PCGPlanner left, PCGHub right) each with a title bar, and a thin grey strip of user instructions at the bottom; an orange arrow climbs from the Blender icon into the first render.

lesson: Open with a full-width band of the system's own renders cut into slanted strips, then give each component its own titled box below; a bottom strip with the user instructions in the same left-to-right order as the renders links input to output without arrows.
